The real-device Rust checks passed, including complex-field accuracy, cancellation, translation invariance, and tiny attenuation. The first sampling cases have completed; I’m checking the raw measurements rather than relying on the headline speedup fields.

All 20 GPU cases passed. The strongest large cases show about 11× faster cached field applications and 10× faster coefficient pullbacks; fused fields show roughly 3–4× gains against the best measured CPU alternative. Tiny cases are substantially slower on the GPU, and setup costs matter.
